title: Crypto-Cash Back: How to Redeem Rewards in Your Crypto Wallet
summary: Explains how to redeem Crypto-Cash Back rewards in a crypto wallet: you must have redemption enabled and a minimum reward balance of $30. Steps cover choosing Redeem to Crypto, selecting up to 12 available cryptocurrencies, entering/confirming a wallet address, reviewing estimates, and submitting. A 1.25% conversion fee applies at the time of conversion.
